name: Kudou Kouji
source: Kouji used to be a very shy schoolmate from [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s high school but not anymore. Ever since last year's events, he has been maturing and now he has a way more easy-going and relaxed type of personality. He decided to join the chemistry club this year in order to be more closer to his crush, Takuya. His love for him hasn't waned yet and he is eagerly awaiting for the day when Takuya will transform into a woman once again. [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]That day[/url] might just come out sooner than he originally anticipated.
